task: Analyze energy flow through a food web diagram
query: How do I analyze energy flow through a food web diagram?

goal.title: Label a food web diagram and draw an energy pyramid
goal.description: On a tablet drawing app, circles producer organisms on a pre-drawn food web diagram with a stylus and labels groups of organisms as Producers, Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary Consumers, drawing connecting arrows between them to show energy flow. Starts a new page to explain that only about 10% of energy transfers between trophic levels, sketches an energy pyramid, and labels its tiers with the same organisms before returning to the original diagram to point out examples.
goal.final_state: The food web diagram is fully labeled by trophic level and a separate energy pyramid page illustrates the 10% energy-transfer rule; the clip ends with the presenter pointing to organisms on the original diagram.
procedure: Circle organisms on the food-web diagram and label primary consumers.
Draw connections and add tertiary-consumer labels.
Write the ten-percent energy-transfer note and sketch a pyramid beside the food web.
Label the pyramid tiers and point to corresponding organisms.
Point to examples on the annotated food web.

phases.description: Circle the producer organisms and label the primary consumers.
Label the producers and secondary consumers.
Draw energy-flow lines and label the tertiary consumers.
Explain the ten percent energy rule and draw an energy pyramid.
Label the energy pyramid's trophic levels with organisms.
Point out organisms on the original food web diagram.

coarse.instruction: Circle producers and label the primary consumers
coarse.description: Circles the grass and flowering plant on the food web diagram with a stylus, then writes 'Primary Consumers' beside the organisms that eat them.
coarse.goal_contribution: Identifies the plants and the organisms feeding on them.

coarse.instruction: Label the producers and secondary consumers
coarse.description: Taps the color palette and writes 'Producers' near the plants, then labels the frog and snake as secondary consumers.
coarse.goal_contribution: Adds more trophic-level labels to the food web.
coarse.predictability_reason: After marking primary consumers, labeling producers and secondary consumers continues the food web.

coarse.instruction: Draw energy-flow lines and label tertiary consumers
coarse.description: Draws connecting arrows between organisms on the diagram and writes 'Tertiary Consumers' beside the top predators.
coarse.goal_contribution: Connects organisms and labels the upper consumer level.
coarse.predictability_reason: The partly labeled web is ready for flow lines and top consumers.

coarse.instruction: Explain the ten percent rule and draw a pyramid
coarse.description: Starts a new page explaining that only 10% of energy transfers between levels, then sketches an energy pyramid outline.
coarse.goal_contribution: Adds a visual explanation of reduced energy at successive levels.
coarse.predictability_reason: A labeled food web supports explaining energy transfer and drawing the pyramid.

coarse.instruction: Label the energy pyramid's trophic levels
coarse.description: Points to organisms with the stylus while adding their icons and labels to each tier of the energy pyramid.
coarse.goal_contribution: Maps the food-web organisms onto the pyramid levels.
coarse.predictability_reason: The drawn energy pyramid needs its trophic levels labeled.

coarse.instruction: Point out organisms on the food web diagram
coarse.description: Returns to the food web diagram and points out organisms with a finger to recap the energy-flow concept.
coarse.goal_contribution: Reviews the annotated relationships using examples on the diagram.
coarse.predictability_reason: After labeling the pyramid, returning to the web for recap is plausible but optional.
